mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate sharp consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production during a supply-driven slowdown increases production costs and reduces corporate output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales reflects strong consumer spending that boosts corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in payroll employment signals severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rate increases risk-free rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
